title: Naturally Flaky Syrian Dough Flatbread
description: This traditional Syrian flatbread is made with a yeasty dough and features a flaky texture, scotch bonnet peppers, and a mushimono-steam cooking method, all while being Whole30-friendly.
instructions: Combine warm water and yeast in a large bowl, stirring to dissolve the yeast.
Add coconut flour, diced scotch bonnet peppers, and salt to the bowl, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased wok, cover with a lid, and steam over boiling water for 15 minutes.
Remove the lid and brush the dough with olive oil and apple cider vinegar.
Continue to steam for an additional 5 minutes, or until the dough is cooked through and flaky.
Remove from heat and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve warm, garnished with additional scotch bonnet peppers if desired.
